desc:
TIME MOVES ONLY WHEN YOU MOVE.

Experience SUPERROT in Roblox, the unique first-person shooter where time slows down when you stop moving.

Outnumbered and outgunned, use your surroundings, dodge incoming bullets, disarm enemies, and fight your way through intense, action-packed levels.

Tags: slow motion, first person shooter, bullet time, time control, dodge bullets, action puzzle, FPS, single player, melee combat, throwing weapons, reflex challenge, minimalist, strategy, stylized combat, tactical shooter
